subject: SOURCE FORMAT directive
notes: kb/Work PB1361 (w70b): '4) A SOURCE FORMAT directive that is the first line of a compilation group or library text may be in either fixed form or free form.' (cite.py --check 7.3.24.3 -> OK §7.3.24.3 4)). FormatSegments reads line 1 in the format in effect and, failing that, as a SOURCE FORMAT directive in the other format, so '>>SOURCE FORMAT FREE' in column 1 of line 1 switches a text that starts fixed, and 'SEQ001 >>SOURCE FORMAT FREE' (letters in the sequence area, §6.3.2 'may consist of any character' -> OK §6.3.2) is a fixed-form directive (probe p6d prints P6D-OK; before: COBOL0001 unexpected 'SEQ001').
